newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel little changed against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel little changed against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel closed almost unchanged against the dollar on Monday ahead of the Bank of Israel announcement on interest rates, dealers said.
The bank will announce its January monetary programme, including interest rates, at about 1500 GMT. The current base rate is 15.2 percent.
"The market was very quiet today as investors expect a moderate rate cut of 0.5 percentage point or even less. Such a cut will have no impact on trading," said Israel Sapir of Bank Leumi.
"Many companies are waiting for a much sharper cut before they will start selling dollars," Sapir added.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2690 shekels against 3.2700 shekels on Friday. The basket composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6522 shekels against 3.6489 on Friday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.8645 shekels per 100 yen versus 2.8609 on Friday and against the mark at 2.1054 shekels versus 2.1011 on Friday.
In late afternoon the dollar continued to trade at 3.2700 shekels.
